answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with a decaying stake bond: every identity locks collateral that is slashed when it signs two conflicting attestations. Reaching the summit of consensus therefore needs thousands of distinct bonds funded at once. Even a comet burst of newborn agents is exposed, because their deposits trace back to one paymaster. On a crystal clear ledger of signatures, each fraud burns real collateral, so an attacker loses far more in slashed stake than any single forged vote could earn.
